notes: The page has NO walkthrough -- the front matter flags it no_walkthrough -- so the single step is read entirely from the header: Heizo in Norg (H-7), Item Reqs '10 Rusty Leggings', and the Description's own sentence 'Heizo will accept them one at a time.' That last clause is the whole shape of the quest and is the reason this is not a ten-count trade: it is ten trades of one, so items carries a single pair, which is genuinely what you must hold to perform the step. Nothing reports how many of the ten Heizo has taken, so the ladder cannot be advanced through the loop -- the one rung simply stays lit until the quest closes, which is the honest model rather than ten fake rungs. source_bullets is empty because there are no bullets to cite; the step comes from the header. Demoted to medium for the missing walkthrough, not because the header is unclear -- it is not. Dokumori: Ichi is the Reward and so cannot be evidence.

steps.note: ten pairs in total, one per trade -- the header says he accepts them one at a time. Zone and grid come from the Start field, since there is no walkthrough to place him.

notes: Two bullets, two real actions on the same NPC, and they stay two steps rather than collapsing the way A Feather in One's Cap did -- there bullet 1 was a precondition (zone after the previous quest), here it is a conversation you actually have, and the page says outright that it is what begins the quest. Consecutive steps on one NPC draw one marker anyway, so nothing is lost by keeping the rung. The Lion Springs Tavern is an interior of Southern San d'Oria, not a zone, so both steps sit at (K-6) in Southern San d'Oria. The header writes '4 Flint Stones'; the plural does not resolve, so the item is Flint Stone with count 4 in a single trade. Nothing in this quest is observable -- no key item, no intermediate hold, and the 100 gil is the Reward -- so both steps have null evidence.

One bullet, one action, and it is the whole quest. The header files the three fangs under 'Quest Reqs' rather than 'Item Reqs' -- that is a mis-filing, not a second gate: there is no prerequisite quest, level or job anywhere on the page, so gates.level and gates.jobs stay empty and the fangs are simply the trade's items. The walkthrough never tells you to speak to Taumila first, it goes straight to the trade, so no opening talk step is invented on the strength of what similar San d'Oria fetch quests usually do. The 2100 gil is the Reward and cannot be evidence, and the fangs are the thing you are handing over rather than something obtained at this step, so evidence is null.

The walkthrough is a single unnumbered prose line rather than a numbered list, so source_bullets cites it as [1]. 'Obtain 2 Bat Wings and trade them to Secodiand' is one instruction and not two: obtaining the wings is exactly what the trade's items already assert you must hold, so it gets no rung of its own -- unlike Operation Teatime, where the shopping was a separate bullet with two different items to gather and a real gap before the hand-in. The header's plural 'Bat Wings' does not resolve; the item is Bat Wing, count 2, in one trade. As with Tiger's Teeth the page never says to speak to Secodiand first, so no opening talk is invented. The 200 gil is the Reward and so is not evidence, and nothing else here is observable.
